title: Step6_LLMAgentActionDecision
description: Schema of the structured decision output by Multimodal LLM (DeepSeek-R1 / Groq / OpenAI)

Reasoning.description: Detailed reasoning explaining current screen context and the logical rationale for the chosen action

Next Action.description: Action name and description: left_click, type, right_click, double_click, hover, scroll_down, scroll_up, wait, or None

Box ID.description: Target numeric Box ID identified from the SoM annotated image

value.description: String text value to type into the targeted input element (required if Next Action is 'type')
